title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: App Blocks turn requests into interactive apps in the conversation
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing context and admin path are supported, and targeted searches found no App Blocks-specific documentation. One qualification is needed: Microsoft's Copilot Chat guidance says Integrated Apps blocking covers Teams, while the general Integrated Apps reference says Teams retains its separate settings.
